# infisical_audit_log_stream_cribl (Resource)

Stream organization audit logs to Cribl. Requires a plan with audit log streaming and an identity with organization settings permissions. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_audit_log_stream_cribl" "pipeline" {
  credentials = {
    url   = "https://<your-cribl-worker-host>:10080/cribl/_bulk"
    token = "<your-cribl-http-source-token>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Attributes) The Cribl delivery credentials. Secret values cannot be read back from the API, so drift in them is not detected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes) Scopes which audit logs the stream receives. Omit to stream every product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The audit log stream ID.
- `stream_mode` (String) How events are delivered. Read-only: new streams are always created in batch mode.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `token` (String, Sensitive) The Cribl Stream HTTP source token. The API requires it on every update, so a token rotated outside Terraform must be mirrored here or the next apply reverts it.
- `url` (String) The Cribl Stream HTTP source URL.


<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Optional:

- `products` (Set of String) Products to stream: secret-manager, cert-manager, kms, secret-scanning, pam, agent-vault, organization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import infisical_audit_log_stream_cribl.example <audit_log_stream_id>

# The API never returns credential secrets, so the first plan after an import shows the token
# being set.
```
